scope: Independent local read-only source, Python AST, byte/hash and existing JSON schema review. No target module was imported, no collector/sealer/native helper/binder/auditor/parser/CI/Rust/benchmark was executed, and no host API or Git ref was used.

static_identity_checks.fixed_input_scope: Twelve actual deployed CI preparation files including the deployment manifest, plus seven actual completed D2 qualification originals.
static_identity_checks.create_archive_delta: Only kind/description, output basename and manifest schema change from the original reviewed D1 qualification collector.
static_identity_checks.verify_archive_delta: Only archive schema and kind strings change; bounded read/decompression, member checks, original scanner and zero filesystem extraction remain unchanged.
static_identity_checks.ci_commands_and_environment: The six argv values and environment equal the completed original D1 CI report after the explicit D1-to-D2 root replacement; no execution flag or nextest 0.9.137 requirement changes.

selection_and_bindings.original_native_read_pages: Exactly one original rust-ci-native-read-01.json, or 1..16 ordered numbered original pages; no synthesized combined raw page.
selection_and_bindings.whole_original_ci_directory: rust-ci-01 is recursively collected with the unchanged explicit ELF/profile/credential exclusions, including all original six-stage stdout/stderr files and any other retained CI directory files.
selection_and_bindings.positive_stream_bindings: Each of six original stage records must identify both raw stdout and stderr retained bytes/SHA; nextest raw stderr is bound to the original audit and complete unfiltered exact-case inventory in the original full plan.
selection_and_bindings.source_and_binary_scope: The archived plan, Q source map/report and original CI source-unchanged statement are compared. Release/test ELF bodies, runtime source bodies, caches and original audit code are not re-executed or rehashed by this collector.

future_and_failure_semantics.positive_counts: Taken from the original completed CI audit, then compared to the original CI plan and Q counts; qualification success alone cannot create CI success.
future_and_failure_semantics.failure_preservation: A complete durable failed native attempt with nonzero exit may retain absent plan/report/audit and existing original stage outcomes. A nonzero stage is preserved rather than relabeled successful; no CI or audit rerun is performed.
future_and_failure_semantics.original_native_streams: Full job identity, native seen/stored counts, durable terminal, sequential offsets, raw bytes_hex/text, per-page EOF and final EOF are checked with the original helpers.
future_and_failure_semantics.sealer_boundary: Pure local original-byte/JSON checks and AST literal injection only. Its receipt explicitly states the stage raw-stream recheck remains the collector's responsibility.

preserved_limits.stable_read: Canonical path, regular single-link file, O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK|O_CLOEXEC and matching before/after/path stat.
preserved_limits.archive_write: Create-only outputs, O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW, original payload bytes, deterministic gzip/tar metadata and fsync.
preserved_limits.verification: Bounded archive and expanded tar in memory; original size/member/path/link/scanner checks and zero filesystem extraction.

limitations: Actual D2 CI result pins are deliberately unset in the reviewed templates; this review does not declare CI, collection or archive verification complete.
This is a narrow adaptation review, not a new source/ELF audit or a rerun of the original nextest auditor.
Original malformed/missing required native originals fail closed; no replacement receipt is fabricated.
